title: My Morning
summary: A short text about a morning routine.

paragraphs.text: I wake up at seven every morning.
paragraphs.translation: I wake up at seven every morning.
paragraphs.translation_en: I wake up at seven every morning.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya bangun jam tujuh setiap pagi.

paragraphs.text: I take a shower and eat breakfast.
paragraphs.translation: I take a shower and eat breakfast.
paragraphs.translation_en: I take a shower and eat breakfast.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya mandi dan makan sarapan.

paragraphs.text: Then I go to work by bus.
paragraphs.translation: Then I go to work by bus.
paragraphs.translation_en: Then I go to work by bus.
paragraphs.translation_id: Lalu saya pergi bekerja naik bus.

summary_en: A short text about a morning routine.

paragraphs.text: My family has four people.
paragraphs.translation: My family has four people.
paragraphs.translation_en: My family has four people.
paragraphs.translation_id: Keluarga saya ada empat orang.

paragraphs.text: My father is a doctor, and my mother is a teacher.
paragraphs.translation: My father is a doctor, and my mother is a teacher.
paragraphs.translation_en: My father is a doctor, and my mother is a teacher.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ayah saya dokter, dan ibu saya guru.

paragraphs.text: I have one younger brother. He is a student.
paragraphs.translation: I have one younger brother. He is a student.
paragraphs.translation_en: I have one younger brother. He is a student.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya punya satu adik laki-laki. Dia seorang pelajar.

paragraphs.text: Classes start at eight in the morning.
paragraphs.translation: Classes start at eight in the morning.
paragraphs.translation_en: Classes start at eight in the morning.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kelas dimulai jam delapan pagi.

paragraphs.text: We study English, math, and science.
paragraphs.translation: We study English, math, and science.
paragraphs.translation_en: We study English, math, and science.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami belajar bahasa Inggris, matematika, dan sains.

paragraphs.text: Lunch is at twelve, and school ends at three.
paragraphs.translation: Lunch is at twelve, and school ends at three.
paragraphs.translation_en: Lunch is at twelve, and school ends at three.
paragraphs.translation_id: Makan siang jam dua belas, dan sekolah selesai jam tiga.

paragraphs.text: My town is small and quiet.
paragraphs.translation: My town is small and quiet.
paragraphs.translation_en: My town is small and quiet.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kota saya kecil dan tenang.

paragraphs.text: There is a park, a bank, and two restaurants.
paragraphs.translation: There is a park, a bank, and two restaurants.
paragraphs.translation_en: There is a park, a bank, and two restaurants.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ada taman, bank, dan dua restoran.

paragraphs.text: People are very friendly here.
paragraphs.translation: People are very friendly here.
paragraphs.translation_en: People are very friendly here.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang-orang di sini sangat ramah.

paragraphs.text: Today the weather is very nice.
paragraphs.translation: Today the weather is very nice.
paragraphs.translation_en: Today the weather is very nice.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hari ini cuacanya sangat bagus.

paragraphs.text: The sky is blue and the sun is warm.
paragraphs.translation: The sky is blue and the sun is warm.
paragraphs.translation_en: The sky is blue and the sun is warm.
paragraphs.translation_id: Langit biru dan matahari hangat.

paragraphs.text: It is a good day for a walk.
paragraphs.translation: It is a good day for a walk.
paragraphs.translation_en: It is a good day for a walk.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hari yang pas untuk jalan-jalan.

paragraphs.text: My favorite food is pizza.
paragraphs.translation: My favorite food is pizza.
paragraphs.translation_en: My favorite food is pizza.
paragraphs.translation_id: Makanan favorit saya adalah pizza.

paragraphs.text: I eat pizza with my friends on weekends.
paragraphs.translation: I eat pizza with my friends on weekends.
paragraphs.translation_en: I eat pizza with my friends on weekends.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya makan pizza bersama teman-teman di akhir pekan.

paragraphs.text: It is delicious, but it is very expensive.
paragraphs.translation: It is delicious, but it is very expensive.
paragraphs.translation_en: It is delicious, but it is very expensive.
paragraphs.translation_id: Enak, tapi harganya sangat mahal.

paragraphs.text: My hobby is taking photos.
paragraphs.translation: My hobby is taking photos.
paragraphs.translation_en: My hobby is taking photos.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hobi saya adalah memotret.

paragraphs.text: I like to take pictures of animals and nature.
paragraphs.translation: I like to take pictures of animals and nature.
paragraphs.translation_en: I like to take pictures of animals and nature.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya suka memotret hewan dan alam.

paragraphs.text: On Sundays I go to the park with my camera.
paragraphs.translation: On Sundays I go to the park with my camera.
paragraphs.translation_en: On Sundays I go to the park with my camera.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setiap hari Minggu saya pergi ke taman membawa kamera.

paragraphs.text: I went to the supermarket this morning.
paragraphs.translation: I went to the supermarket this morning.
paragraphs.translation_en: I went to the supermarket this morning.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya pergi ke supermarket pagi ini.

paragraphs.text: I bought some bread, milk, and fruit.
paragraphs.translation: I bought some bread, milk, and fruit.
paragraphs.translation_en: I bought some bread, milk, and fruit.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya membeli roti, susu, dan buah.

paragraphs.text: Everything was cheap, so I was happy.
paragraphs.translation: Everything was cheap, so I was happy.
paragraphs.translation_en: Everything was cheap, so I was happy.
paragraphs.translation_id: Semuanya murah, jadi saya senang.

paragraphs.text: I have a small dog named Max.
paragraphs.translation: I have a small dog named Max.
paragraphs.translation_en: I have a small dog named Max.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya punya anjing kecil bernama Max.

paragraphs.text: He is black and very friendly.
paragraphs.translation: He is black and very friendly.
paragraphs.translation_en: He is black and very friendly.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia berwarna hitam dan sangat ramah.

paragraphs.text: I take him to the park every day.
paragraphs.translation: I take him to the park every day.
paragraphs.translation_en: I take him to the park every day.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya mengajaknya ke taman setiap hari.

paragraphs.text: Last weekend I visited my grandmother.
paragraphs.translation: Last weekend I visited my grandmother.
paragraphs.translation_en: Last weekend I visited my grandmother.
paragraphs.translation_id: Akhir pekan lalu saya mengunjungi nenek saya.

paragraphs.text: We cooked lunch together and talked a lot.
paragraphs.translation: We cooked lunch together and talked a lot.
paragraphs.translation_en: We cooked lunch together and talked a lot.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami memasak makan siang bersama dan banyak mengobrol.

paragraphs.text: I had a very good time.
paragraphs.translation: I had a very good time.
paragraphs.translation_en: I had a very good time.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya bersenang-senang sekali.
